description: Analyses whose movement hops keep the continuing id at the source, the form Babel gives every hop. The moved phrase's lower occurrence keeps its id and becomes a silent trace, while its content moves on under the new landing id. Neither change is a displacement for another claim of the stage to own, and a pending movement still restores its source until its own moment.

cases.source: GPT-6.1 Sol, high reasoning, Codex OAuth qualification run with the character spell-out contract (v3), commit bcf1b56, 19 October 2026 (fourth night batch, 04-en-raising-control-mix, analysis 1 of 2; analysis 2 repeats the shape in its stage 6). Tokens are the model’s own final words. Here the hop is renamed so the source keeps aCommittee and the landing is aCommitteeTrace; nothing else changes. A finite subject licensing claim names the landing and, in its prior anchors, aCommittee: the source-kept trace once made that claim own the whole matrix clause, so seems, I and I′ were never built and appeared at a later claim.
cases.sentence: The committee seems to have persuaded the director to try to appear to be satisfied with the proposal.

values.case: not assigned in this infinitival clause

derivationStages.stageRecord: Persuade projects its nominal object and infinitival CP as two lexically licensed complements of V′. It assigns the committee its external Agent role in Spec-IP, the director its object role, and the try CP its propositional role. Persuade governs the director and assigns it accusative Case. The director, rather than the committee, obligatorily controls the subject PRO of try; together with the existing subject-control dependency, this makes the director the understood trier and the understood subject of apparent satisfaction. Perfect have selects the participial VP headed by persuaded, and infinitival to heads the containing IP. The committee has its theta-role here but cannot receive nominative from this infinitival I; its Case requirement remains pending.
derivationStages.statement: Build the perfect persuasion clause and establish object control.

derivationStages.stageRecord: Seem selects the previously constructed infinitival IP directly and assigns no external theta-role. The committee moves from that IP's subject position to matrix Spec-IP, leaving an A-trace. The resulting chain receives its sole theta-role from persuade at the lower position. Finite matrix I assigns nominative to the raised NP, resolving the previously pending Case requirement and satisfying the matrix subject requirement. Matrix agreement is third-person singular, matching committee and the lexical finite form seems. This analysis uses abstract finite I with inflection already realized on the lexical verb; it does not posit V-to-I movement. A null declarative C completes the root CP. The two raising dependencies are thus distinct from the two control dependencies: the committee raises across seem, while the PRO interpreted as the director raises across appear.
derivationStages.statement: Complete the sentence by raising the committee to the finite matrix subject position.

cases.source: GPT-6.1 Sol, high reasoning, Codex OAuth qualification run, commit 35e88f0, 29 October 2026 (held-out batch heldout-20261029, h1-054-ml-complement-clause, analysis 1 of 1). The analysis's stages 4 and 5; stages 1–3 are trimmed and the first stage here keeps its forest with its relations removed. Every hop of the whole analysis is renamed so the source keeps the continuing id. The CP's lineage is declared only in the second stage, where its lower occurrence keeps eCP as a silent trace: the V-to-I moment once showed the CP landing before the CP scrambling moment, whose arrow was lost.
cases.sentence: അവൻ നാളെ വരും എന്ന് അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു.

derivationStages.statement: Project the matrix IP and license its subject.
derivationStages.stageRecord: The matrix VP combines with past INFL in head-final order. അവൾ raises from Spec-VP to Spec-IP, leaving its subject trace. Matrix finite INFL licenses nominative Case on അവൾ and satisfies the matrix subject requirement. At this point ordinary subject raising would place അവൾ before the embedded CP; a further independently represented operation is therefore needed to derive the input's CP–subject–verb order.

derivationStages.statement: Raise the matrix verb and scramble the reported-content CP to derive the attested order.
derivationStages.stageRecord: The matrix verb പറഞ്ഞു raises from V⁰ to past INFL, leaving a head trace and forming the finite past predicate. The embedded CP then scrambles from the complement position of the matrix verb to a left-adjoined position on matrix IP, leaving a CP trace. This independently motivated ordering operation produces exactly the input's reported-clause–subject–verb sequence: അവൻ നാളെ വരും എന്ന് അവൾ പറഞ്ഞു. The CP's thematic interpretation remains connected to its complement trace. Finally, the embedded pronoun അവൻ and the matrix pronoun അവൾ are each free in their respective local finite clauses, satisfying Binding Principle B; neither subject movement chain is a pronominal binding dependency.

values.path: matrix V-complement to left-adjoined position on matrix IP
values.chainInterpretation: reported Content is interpreted through the complement trace
